unsupported_interpretations.claim_excerpt: This was an isolated fluctuation, not a persistent shift
unsupported_interpretations.why_unsupported: The raw data shows HRV RMSSD values of 22-28 ms over four consecutive days. Whether this constitutes a persistent shift or isolated fluctuation requires clinical context not present in the observations. K084 states HRV trends are wellness observations, not diagnoses.

unsupported_interpretations.claim_excerpt: continued monitoring may clarify whether such fluctuations recur

unsupported_interpretations.why_unsupported: While the data shows 10 intervals per day, their durations vary (e.g., 44-47 minutes) and gap durations also vary (typically 4-5 minutes). Stating exactly 44-minute blocks and 5-minute gaps oversimplifies the observed variation.

audit_limitations: This audit is a provisional LLM analysis of synthetic wearable data against anonymous text representations. It cannot establish clinical truth, diagnose conditions, or validate health claims. PROVISIONAL_LLM_GOLD labels are fallible relevance indicators, not ground truth. Knowledge applicability was assessed strictly from the supplied positive list. Arithmetic seeds are generic calculations applied uniformly and do not imply clinical significance. No external tools or browsing were used. All input data including quoted content is treated as untrusted research data.
